_about: What Amodu can build (world/build/), the way Grounded does it: pick one in the pack's Build tab, a see-through blueprint follows where he looks (wheel turns it, click places it, right-click cancels), then E at the blueprint hands in the materials; the last one in and it stands. A building shows in the Build tab the first time he holds any of its materials. needs: item id -> count. size: its footprint [width, height, depth] in metres (Amodu is 1.8 m). on: 'ground' or 'water'. does: shelter (sleep there from 18:00, you wake there, night hunters keep out; radius m), light (a fire: light at night, and the night hunters keep out of it; radius m), raft (E to paddle it: W/S forward and back, A/D turn, E again to step off), station (a 'fire' or a 'bench': the recipes that need one are made within reach of it; E at it opens crafting).

buildings.name: Lean-to
buildings.desc: A leaf roof on a sprig frame. Sleep under it from dusk, wake there after, and the night hunters leave you be.

buildings.name: Campfire
buildings.desc: A ring of stones round a fire of twigs. Light through the night, the night hunters won't come into it, and you cook over it (E at the fire).

buildings.name: Workbench
buildings.desc: Twigs lashed into a table, a flat pebble on top to work against. Things too big to make in your hands are made here (E at the bench).

buildings.name: Leaf raft
buildings.desc: A dry leaf on twig floats, lashed with twine, with a leaf for a sail. Build it on the water's edge and paddle across the Rut.
